Name: SIPR
Segments:

- Experience working in high-security DoD environments (e.g., SIPR, JWICS).

Name: BR
Segments:
- You have solid, hands-on knowledge of Brazilian GAAP (BR GAAP) and IFRS fundamentals, with direct experience in month-end close and Balance Sheet reconciliations;
- All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.
- By joining the Payments BR tribe, you’ll help shape solutions that directly solve merchants’ everyday challenges and redefine how financial products empower entrepreneurship in Brazil.

Name: Fierce Healthcare
Segments:
- Learn more about our Series C: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.
- Our awards include: 2023 and 2024 BuiltIn Best Place to Work; Top 5 LinkedIn Startup; TripleTree iAward; multiple KLAS Research Points of Light awards, along with recognition on Fierce Healthcare's Fierce 15 and CB Insights' Digital Health 150 lists.
- The company's award-winning solutions were recognized again in 2024 by KLAS Research, Fierce Healthcare, and AVIA Marketplace.

Name: Inductive
Segments:
- Experience selecting and integrating sensors and actuators (encoders, force/torque, vision, capacitive/inductive, pneumatics, motors, bearings) with clear understanding of physics and failure modes.
- We believe a graph-based approach that analyzes relationships across data on a topological level provides the correct inductive bias for long-context multimodal reasoning.
- HMI and SCADA Software (e.g., FactoryTalk View, Ignition by Inductive Automation, Wonderware, GE iFIX)

Name: SuiteFoundation
Segments:
- NetSuite SuiteFoundation, Administrator, Application Developer, or Web Services certification preferred but not required
- NetSuite Administrator and/or ERP Consultant certification required; SuiteFoundation or SuiteCloud Developer certification strongly preferred.
- NetSuite Administrator certification (SuiteFoundation or Administrator).

Name: Cp
Segments:
- Establish process capability studies (Cp, Cpk) and drive continuous improvement
- Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to establish SPC methods, capability studies (Cp, Cpk), yield targets, and build monitoring frameworks that support production stability and COGS objectives.
- Discipline depth in civil/structural, mechanical, electrical, or NDE with the associated code sets (ACI/AISC, ASME Section III/V/IX, IEEE/ISA, SNT-TC-1A / CP-189).

Name: Guru
Segments:
- Distributed Systems Guru: Proven ability to build systems that handle consensus, replication, and partitioning at cloud scale.
- Help oversee the configuration, maintenance, performance, and optimization of the general CS tech stack (e.g. WFM & QA tooling, apps, company tools Notion, Guru, Slack, Okta etc.)
- As the Procurement Lead, you'll be the APAC Procurement guru for SAP S/4HANA and SAP Ariba transformation projects.

Name: Authenticator
Segments:
- Microsoft 365 & End-User Technologies: Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Office, Copilot, Windows OS, Defender, MFA, Authenticator
- Manage user MFA setup and issues with Microsoft Authenticator.
- Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app.

Name: ICAM
Segments:
- Hands-on expertise in ICAM, micro-segmentation, cloud security, and policy enforcement.
- Ensure compliance with DISA STIGs, DoD ICAM Reference Design, and DoDI 8520.03.
- North Point Technology is looking to hire an ICAM Architect to support a significant modernization effort transitioning legacy Identity, Credentialing, and Access Management (ICAM) capabilities to modern on-premises and cloud-ready technologies, improved architectural patterns, and automated deployment pipelines.

Name: RHCSA
Segments:
- Professional certifications such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or CompTIA Linux+, and Security+.
- RHCSA/LPIC 1/2, CKA, or Docker Certified Associate certification.
- Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, RHCSA, VCP, or equivalent

Name: NR
Segments:
- Document the planned F-35 external IO design in the Department of Defense Communications Information Officer (DoD CIO)-mandated architectural views and the associated F-35 military standards compliance to support Joint Staff’s Joint Net Ready Key Performance Parameter (NR KPP) certification as well as Joint IO certification by the Joint IO Test Command (JITC)
- LTE and 5G NR protocol stacks, including RRC, MAC, RLC, and PDCP layer behavior and configuration.
- Experience with core Audio DSP algorithms and their implementations, including AEC, Beamforming, NR, AGC, VAD, DoA estimation etc.

Name: RingCentral
Segments:
- Experience in Axon applications (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, JIRA, and RingCentral)
- Manage vendor portfolio relationships with companies like Zoom, Slack and Ringcentral
- In this role, you will serve as the technical bridge connecting cloud telephony platforms (RingCentral), conversational AI engines (Amelia, SoundHound), and core clinical infrastructure (Epic EHR).

Name: RT
Segments:
- Architect and develop deterministic, safety-critical control software on real-time Linux (e.g., PREEMPT_RT) and embedded microcontroller/DSP targets, including scheduling, timing, and fault-tolerant control logic.
- Implement and maintain real-time systems using RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, RT Linux, VxWorks).
- Real-time tuning — PREEMPT_RT, latency analysis

Name: CI-CD
Segments:
- Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices applied to PLM deployments, containerization, microservices.
- Familiarity with GitHub workflows and DevOps/CI-CD pipelines to align with software development cycles.
- Experience building and maintaining distributed systems, web frameworks, or CI CD pipelines.

Name: SSG
Segments:
- Frontend: Hands-on proficiency with React and its ecosystem — Next.js (SSR/SSG), TypeScript, state management (Redux, Zustand, or similar), component libraries, and build tooling (Webpack/Vite)
- Build performant, accessible React/Next.js + TypeScript UIs; apply SSR/SSG pragmatically, instrument analytics, and support experimentation/A‑B testing.
- Proficiency with Next.js and modern React patterns: Hooks, Context API, Custom Hooks architecture, SSR/SSG, and the App Router.

Name: cATO
Segments:
- Familiarity with Linux, VMware, AWS, or enterprise networking/security (Palo Alto, Cato Networks).
- Dark Wolf is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to join a collaborative team to develop, manage, and maintain the security posture of cloud-based information systems with a focus on SIEM validation, continuous exposure management, and continuous Authorization to Operate (cATO) support.
- Automated Security Integration & Continuous ATO: Spearhead the seamless integration of dynamic security tools and automated governance into pipelines—including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and container analysis—to support Continuous Authority to Operate (cATO).

Name: MTU
Segments:
- Strong knowledge of Linux networking, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, routing, MTU, congestion control, packet loss, latency, and performance tuning.
- Demonstrate strong expertise across core network technologies, including the OSI model; fibre, CWDM and DWDM transmission services; Ethernet and layer 2 switching, including VLANs, STP, MTU and layer 2 security; IPv4 and IPv6; VRF; GRE; routing protocols such as HSRP, VRRP, OSPF, EIGRP and BGP; route-based IPsec VPNs; multicast; QoS; MPLS and EoMPLS; network security and 802.1x; DNS; DHCP; and RADIUS.
- Guide the customer's infrastructure and platform teams through the layers underneath Portworx: LUN presentation and masking, multipath behavior, LVM layout, HBA and NIC choices, MTU and bonding, VLAN and routing boundaries, hypervisor datastore and passthrough decisions. Their engineers execute; you make sure the design is sound and the tradeoffs are understood

Name: Wix
Segments:
- StarTree Cloud delivers the same as a fully managed platform — so teams like Razorpay, Blinkit, Stripe, Wix, Rippling, together.ai, and Dialpad get real-time analytics at scale without managing the infrastructure.
- Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
- Own Windows installer engineering: MSI/EXE packages built with the WiX Toolset, silent install and uninstall flows (/quiet, /norestart), upgrade paths, and code signing that keeps us clear of SmartScreen and Defender blocks.

Name: Splash
Segments:
- If you’re looking for an opportunity to make a splash, have a foundational say in a new, exciting and growing platform, and steer the direction on the frontier of data platforms, this team might be a good fit for you.
- Experience with event technology platforms (e.g., Splash, Cvent)
- Secondary administration: support the primary admins in managing the connective tissue of our stack, including but not limited to Reachdesk, Qualified, Demandbase, Pathfactory, and Splash.

Name: SnowPro Core
Segments:
- Snowflake certification, including SnowPro Core, SnowPro Advanced Architect, or SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer, is strongly preferred.
- SnowPro Core certified; SnowPro Advanced: Architect preferred
- SnowPro Core or Administrator certification
